cases.setup: Provide a pinned public Python analyzer checkout with class-scope and multiple-decorator failures, identifiable binding owners, and a public test harness.
checks: The inspection record contains real role bindings and hashed current code anchors.
Public reproduction outcomes distinguish scope lookup from decorator cardinality.
The record establishes typing.overload import identity rather than relying on spelling.
Implementation and assertion files remain unedited.
Unknown owners or mechanisms do not yield an applicability-established output.

cases.setup: Supply an applicability-established context with bound recognizer, diagnostic gate, scope/import representation, and public annotation suite.
checks: The diff searches bare names from inner scopes outward and terminates at the first binding.
A non-typing inner binding cannot fall through to an outer typing.overload import.
Decorator recognition examines the full list and retains existing node and qualified-recognition boundaries.
The diagnostic call site supplies the available scope stack while ordinary diagnostic gating remains intact.
Public assertions cover enclosing imports in a class and additional decorators.
The edit marks public-validation-observed stale without invalidating behavior-assurance or Workflow-invariant keys.

cases.setup: Supply the edited code and assertions, recorded preservation baselines, public probes, and current Oracle bindings with rendered argv commands.
checks: Execution records show whether both historical failure shapes avoid false unused-redefinition diagnostics.
Recorded preservation checks cover ordinary redefinitions, first-binding shadowing, qualified recognition, and function-node restrictions.
The result includes actual commands, outcomes, and unresolved checks.
No implementation or assertion edits occur during validation.
The validation record is associated with the repair Action.
FAIL or UNKNOWN prevents required-public-checks-pass from being established.

cases.setup: Bind public oracles to an edited checkout where a preservation probe fails or a required regression cannot execute.
checks: The outcomes-recorded output retains the actual failure or UNKNOWN result.
Fresh observations are distinguished from passing checks.
The Workflow is not accepted solely because validation ran.
Reported coverage does not exceed executed checks or imply whole-project historical qualification.
